nodes.name: cli_managed_proxy.rs
nodes.summary: Runs a local Axum-based HTTP proxy server that CLI coding agents talk to, resolving each agent's configured provider/model/API-key, rewriting requests, and forwarding them to the correct upstream (Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible) API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Axum routing plus per-agent proxy tokens to multiplex several external CLI tools through one local HTTP endpoint.

nodes.name: start_cli_managed_proxy_thread
nodes.summary: Spawns the background thread that supervises and restarts the local CLI-managed proxy server.

nodes.name: supervise_proxy_server
nodes.summary: Supervises the proxy server task, restarting it with backoff after failures.

nodes.name: proxy_unavailable_message
nodes.summary: Builds the human-readable error message shown when the managed proxy is unavailable.

nodes.name: run_proxy_server
nodes.summary: Builds and serves the Axum router exposing the health, v1, Claude, and per-CLI-agent proxy endpoints.

nodes.name: health_handler
nodes.summary: Axum handler returning the proxy server's health-check response.

nodes.name: proxy_claude_root_handler
nodes.summary: Axum handler forwarding root-path Claude-protocol requests through the managed proxy.

nodes.name: proxy_claude_handler
nodes.summary: Axum handler forwarding path-scoped Claude-protocol requests through the managed proxy.

nodes.name: proxy_agent_handler
nodes.summary: Core Axum handler that authenticates a proxy token, resolves the agent's upstream context, and forwards the request to the correct provider.

nodes.name: empty_ok_response
nodes.summary: Builds an empty 200 OK Axum response.

nodes.name: authenticated_empty_ok_response
nodes.summary: Validates the proxy token for an agent and returns an empty OK response, or an auth error.

nodes.name: forward_request
nodes.summary: Forwards an incoming request to the resolved upstream provider, rewriting headers, auth, and the model field before returning the upstream response.

nodes.name: proxy_token_matches
nodes.summary: Compares a supplied proxy token against the expected token.

nodes.name: rewrite_model_field
nodes.summary: Rewrites the `model` field of an outgoing JSON request body to the agent's selected model.

nodes.name: build_upstream_url
nodes.summary: Builds the full upstream URL for a generic OpenAI-compatible provider request.

nodes.name: build_anthropic_upstream_url
nodes.summary: Builds the full upstream URL for an Anthropic-protocol provider request.

nodes.name: should_forward_header
nodes.summary: Decides whether a given request header should be forwarded upstream.

nodes.name: should_forward_response_header
nodes.summary: Decides whether a given upstream response header should be forwarded back to the client.

nodes.name: apply_auth_header
nodes.summary: Applies the correct provider-specific authorization header (API key) to the outgoing request builder.

nodes.name: protocol_for_agent
nodes.summary: Resolves which proxy protocol (OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible) an agent uses.

nodes.name: resolve_proxy_context_for_selection
nodes.summary: Resolves the full proxy context (provider, model, API key, upstream URL, protocol) for a given agent/key/model selection, generating a fresh proxy token.

nodes.name: resolve_proxy_context
nodes.summary: Resolves the proxy context for an agent using its currently configured key/model selection.

nodes.name: compatible_key_ids_for_agent
nodes.summary: Lists the configured API key IDs compatible with a given agent's provider protocol.

nodes.name: cli_config_enable_orgii_managed
nodes.summary: Tauri command that switches a CLI agent's configuration to use the Orgii-managed proxy for the given key/model.

nodes.name: cli_managed_proxy_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the current managed-proxy status (running, ready, URL, selected key/model) for an agent.

nodes.name: json_error
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON error response body with the given HTTP status and message.

nodes.name: CliManagedProxyStatus
nodes.summary: DTO reporting the CLI-managed proxy's current status and selection for an agent, returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: archive.rs
nodes.summary: Creates zip archives of a folder (with exclusion rules and progress events) and reports folder size/file-count info, used for exporting or backing up project folders.

nodes.name: should_exclude
nodes.summary: Decides whether a file path should be excluded from a folder archive (build artifacts, VCS dirs, etc.).

nodes.name: collect_files_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory collecting file paths to include in an archive.

nodes.name: get_relative_path
nodes.summary: Computes a file's path relative to the archive root for use as a zip entry name.

nodes.name: create_folder_archive
nodes.summary: Tauri command that zips a folder into an in-memory archive, emitting progress events to the window as it goes.

nodes.name: get_folder_info
nodes.summary: Tauri command reporting a folder's file count and estimated archive size before archiving.

nodes.name: ArchiveResult
nodes.summary: DTO carrying the produced archive bytes, size, file count, and folder name back to the frontend.

nodes.name: ArchiveProgress
nodes.summary: Progress event payload emitted to the frontend while archiving a folder.

nodes.name: FolderInfo
nodes.summary: DTO summarizing a folder's file count, total size, and estimated archive size.

nodes.name: frontend_log.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges frontend console logs into the backend's log files via a small Tauri command surface.

nodes.name: write_frontend_log
nodes.summary: Tauri command that writes a frontend console log line into the backend's log files.

nodes.name: get_logs_directory
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the on-disk directory where logs are stored.

nodes.name: housekeeping.rs
nodes.summary: Performs deferred startup disk cleanup, capping and evicting old sessions, manifests, blobs, screenshots and caches, returning aggregate before/after housekeeping stats.

nodes.name: run_deferred_cleanup
nodes.summary: Runs the app's deferred startup cleanup pass, capping/evicting old sessions, manifests, blobs, screenshots, and other caches, and returns aggregate stats.

nodes.name: HousekeepingStats
nodes.summary: Aggregate counters reporting how many items of each category were evicted or capped by a housekeeping run.

nodes.name: index_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of per-repo code-search indexes (create/reuse/release with reference counting) and reports indexing progress/state to the frontend.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty IndexManager with no active indexes.

nodes.name: get_or_index
nodes.summary: Returns the existing index handle for a repo path or kicks off background indexing if none exists.

nodes.name: update_progress
nodes.summary: Updates the state and progress of an in-flight index build for a repo.

nodes.name: release_index
nodes.summary: Tauri command / internal method that releases a repo's index reference, decrementing its reference count and evicting it when unused.

nodes.name: get_all_indexes
nodes.summary: Tauri command / internal method returning snapshots of all currently tracked repo indexes.

nodes.name: get_index
nodes.summary: Looks up the index handle for a given repo path.

nodes.name: start_background_indexing
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that performs the actual code indexing work for a repo and updates its progress.

nodes.name: normalize_repo_path
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes a repo path for use as an index cache key.

nodes.name: hash_repo_path
nodes.summary: Hashes a normalized repo path to a stable short index identifier.

nodes.name: get_index_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the indexing status/progress for a repo path.

nodes.name: start_indexing
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts (or resumes) indexing for a repo path.

nodes.name: IndexHandle
nodes.summary: Handle describing a repo's index build (state, progress, timestamps, reference count).

nodes.name: IndexState
nodes.summary: Enum of index lifecycle states (Pending, Indexing, Ready, Error, Updating).

nodes.name: IndexProgress
nodes.summary: Progress payload reporting indexing phase, files/symbols indexed, and completion percentage.

nodes.name: IndexPhase
nodes.summary: Enum of indexing phases (Scanning, FileIndex, SymbolIndex, SemanticIndex, Complete, Idle).

nodes.name: IndexEntry
nodes.summary: Internal registry entry pairing an index handle with its reference count.

nodes.name: IndexManager
nodes.summary: In-memory registry of all active repo code-search indexes, managing lifecycle, reference counting, and progress reporting.
